=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story cli_entrypoint
summary:      Deliver the root CommonMark command-line interface.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI.md
covers:       CLI-001
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     commonmark executable, standard-input/standard-output parser interface
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Deliver an executable named `commonmark` at the application root. It reads UTF-8 Markdown from
  standard input and writes rendered HTML to standard output. Include a concise README describing
  this interface. Do not use a public Markdown implementation.

## story thematic_atx
summary:      Parse thematic breaks and ATX headings.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-ThematicAtx.md
covers:       BLOCK-001
context:      sources/spec.txt, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     thematic breaks, ATX headings
consumes:     standard-input/standard-output parser interface
depends:      cli_entrypoint
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement thematic breaks and ATX headings according to their CommonMark rules, including
  indentation, delimiter counts, closing hashes, inline content, and precedence against other
  block starts. Run the supplied scoped selector for these sections.

## story setext_paragraphs
summary:      Parse setext headings and paragraphs.
type:         service
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-SetextParagraphs.md
covers:        BLOCK-002
context:       sources/spec.txt, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:         common.md, python.md
provides:      setext headings, paragraphs, blank-line boundaries
consumes:      standard-input/standard-output parser interface
depends:       cli_entrypoint
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Parse paragraph boundaries, blank lines, and single- or multi-line setext headings. Preserve raw
  inline source for later inline parsing. Apply the rule that a setext underline can only turn
  preceding paragraph text into a heading when that text is not another block construct. Run the
  supplied scoped selector for these sections.

## story code_blocks
summary:      Parse indented and fenced code blocks.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CodeBlocks.md
covers:       BLOCK-003
context:      sources/spec.txt, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     indented code blocks, fenced code blocks
consumes:     standard-input/standard-output parser interface
depends:      cli_entrypoint
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Parse indented and fenced code blocks as literal content. Preserve indentation, blank lines,
  trailing whitespace, fence character and length rules, closing conditions, and info strings.
  Indented code must not interrupt a paragraph; fenced code may. Run the supplied scoped selector
  for these sections.

## story html_blocks
summary:      Parse the seven CommonMark HTML block types.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-HTMLBlocks.md
covers:       BLOCK-004
context:      sources/spec.txt, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     HTML blocks
consumes:     standard-input/standard-output parser interface
depends:      cli_entrypoint
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement all seven HTML block types with their specified start and end conditions, paragraph
  interruption rules, and raw-content preservation. Run the supplied scoped selector for this
  section.

## story link_definitions
summary:      Collect document-wide link reference definitions.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-LinkDefinitions.md
covers:       BLOCK-005
context:      sources/spec.txt, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     link reference collection
consumes:     standard-input/standard-output parser interface
depends:      cli_entrypoint
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Collect valid link reference definitions during block parsing, including definitions inside
  containers, for document-wide use by inline parsing. Normalize labels for matching, keep the
  first matching definition, and remove definitions from rendered content. Run the supplied
  scoped selector for this section.

## story block_quotes
summary:      Parse CommonMark block quotes.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-BlockQuotes.md
covers:       BLOCK-006
context:      sources/spec.txt, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     block quotes
consumes:     standard-input/standard-output parser interface
depends:      cli_entrypoint
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Parse block quote markers, nesting, blank lines, consecutiveness, and lazy continuation. Laziness
  applies only when a line continues an existing paragraph; it cannot absorb a line that starts a
  different block. Run the supplied scoped selector for this section.

## story lists
summary:      Parse list items and lists.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Lists.md
covers:       BLOCK-007
context:      sources/spec.txt, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     list items and lists
consumes:     standard-input/standard-output parser interface
depends:      cli_entrypoint
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement bullet and ordered list markers, item boundaries, nesting, continuation indentation,
  blank-line tracking and list tightness, empty items, and ordered-list attributes. Respect the
  paragraph interruption rule and thematic-break precedence. Run the supplied scoped selector
  for these sections.

## story escapes_entities
summary:      Parse backslash escapes and character references.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-EscapesEntities.md
covers:       INLINE-001
context:      sources/spec.txt, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     backslash escapes, character references
consumes:     standard-input/standard-output parser interface
depends:      cli_entrypoint
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Parse escapes of ASCII punctuation and valid HTML5 named, decimal, and hexadecimal character
  references in inline contexts. Preserve literal backslashes when the following character is not
  escapable; do not interpret escapes or references in code spans or code blocks. Run the supplied
  scoped selector for these sections.

## story code_spans_breaks
summary:      Parse code spans and line breaks.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CodeSpansBreaks.md
covers:       INLINE-002
context:      sources/spec.txt, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     code spans, hard line breaks, soft line breaks
consumes:     standard-input/standard-output parser interface
depends:      cli_entrypoint
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Parse matched backtick runs as code spans, converting line endings to spaces and applying the
  specified single-space trimming rule. Render hard breaks from trailing spaces or a terminal
  backslash before a line ending, and preserve soft breaks. These rules do not apply inside code
  spans or HTML tags. Run the supplied scoped selector for these sections.

## story emphasis
summary:      Parse emphasis and strong emphasis.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Emphasis.md
covers:       INLINE-003
context:      sources/spec.txt, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     emphasis and strong emphasis
consumes:     standard-input/standard-output parser interface
depends:      cli_entrypoint
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement delimiter-run parsing for `*` and `_`, including Unicode flanking rules, modulo-three
  matching, nesting, precedence, intraword restrictions for underscores, and unmatched delimiter
  handling. Run the supplied scoped selector for this section.

## story links_images
summary:      Parse inline, reference, and image syntax.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-LinksImages.md
covers:       INLINE-004
context:      sources/spec.txt, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     links, images
consumes:     standard-input/standard-output parser interface, link reference collection
depends:      cli_entrypoint, link_definitions
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Parse inline links and reference links in full, collapsed, and shortcut forms, along with images.
  Enforce destination, title, bracket, nesting, precedence, label normalization, and first-definition
  rules. Image alt text is the plain text content of its description. Run the supplied scoped
  selector for these sections.

## story autolinks_html
summary:      Parse autolinks and raw HTML.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-AutolinksHTML.md
covers:       INLINE-005
context:      sources/spec.txt, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     autolinks, raw inline HTML
consumes:     standard-input/standard-output parser interface
depends:      cli_entrypoint
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Recognize URI and email autolinks with the specified grammars. Preserve valid raw HTML tags,
  comments, processing instructions, declarations, and CDATA in inline content; escape invalid tag
  forms as text. Run the supplied scoped selector for these sections.

## story textual_content
summary:      Render remaining inline textual content.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-TextualContent.md
covers:       INLINE-006
context:      sources/spec.txt, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     textual content rendering
consumes:     standard-input/standard-output parser interface
depends:      cli_entrypoint
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Render uninterpreted text with HTML escaping while preserving internal spaces and Unicode
  content. Run the supplied scoped selector for this section.

## story conformance_verification
summary:      Verify the completed parser with the complete supplied conformance suite.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   VERIFICATION.md
covers:       VERIFY-001
accepts:      st-001
context:      sources/full_test.sh, sources/spec_tests.py, sources/spec.txt, sources/cmark.py, sources/normalize.py
context_roles: |
  sources/full_test.sh: conformance scoring entry point
  sources/spec_tests.py: conformance test harness
  sources/spec.txt: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/cmark.py: reference implementation context
  sources/normalize.py: test helper
stack:        common.md, python.md
consumes:     commonmark executable, thematic breaks, ATX headings, setext headings, paragraphs, blank-line boundaries, indented code blocks, fenced code blocks, HTML blocks, link reference collection, block quotes, lists, backslash escapes, character references, code spans, hard line breaks, soft line breaks, emphasis, strong emphasis, links, images, autolinks, raw inline HTML, textual content
depends:      cli_entrypoint, thematic_atx, setext_paragraphs, code_blocks, html_blocks, link_definitions, block_quotes, lists, escapes_entities, code_spans_breaks, emphasis, links_images, autolinks_html, textual_content
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Run `sh sources/full_test.sh` as the sole unfiltered acceptance check after all parser
  implementation stories complete. Preserve all supplied scoring assets unchanged.
